picks.file: Miensk, Vysoki Rynak. Менск, Высокі Рынак (Lauvergne, 1840) (2).jpg
picks.what: The Upper Market with the cathedral and the town hall, lithograph
picks.why: the old main square in winter; the twin-towered cathedral (former Jesuit church) and town hall tower recognizable
general view of the whole town with its church towers across the skyline

picks.file: Miensk, Trajeckaja hara, Bazylanski. Менск, Траецкая гара, Базылянскі (J. Drazdovič, 1919).jpg
picks.what: The Upper Town seen from the Trinity Hill, ink drawing
picks.why: the towers of the Upper Town churches, including the cathedral, above the old houses; archive number in the top corner trimmed

gaps: P0: only a carved bone cube; P1: nothing; P2: only a portrait; P6: existing 2019 view kept
notes: #5 was drawn by Lauvergne in 1840 and published as a lithograph between 1842 and 1856, so labeled “1840s”. #15 is small (718 × 800) but the only usable P5 view; #17 is a small vertical aerial photo that reads like a map. #12 (Hasciny Dvor, 1911) is only 29 years after #8, so not added as a second P4 view. #18 (Holy Spirit Cathedral panorama, 2013) is a possible P6 alternate but not clearly better than the existing view.
